================================================================================

          if k > bestsize:            # STRICTLY greater -- this is the tie-break

TIE-BREAKING is a consequence of `k > bestsize` plus the iteration order:
  * i ascends outermost => among maximal-length matches the one ENDING earliest
    wins, i.e. the earliest starting i wins.
  * j ascends innermost => for equal i and equal length, the earliest j wins.
  * "longest" is decided first because only a strictly larger k replaces the
    incumbent.
  A later match of the SAME size never displaces an earlier one. Never use
  `k >= bestsize`.

4. get_matching_blocks() -> Array<[i, j, size]>
================================================================================

    la = a.length; lb = b.length
    queue = [[0, la, 0, lb]]
    blocks = []
    while queue not empty:
      [alo, ahi, blo, bhi] = queue.pop()          # LIFO, pop from the END
      [i, j, k] = find_longest_match(alo, ahi, blo, bhi)
      if k != 0:
        blocks.push([i, j, k])
        if alo < i   and blo < j:   queue.push([alo, i, blo, j])       # left part
        if i+k < ahi and j+k < bhi: queue.push([i+k, ahi, j+k, bhi])   # right part
      # k == 0 => nothing matches in this window; drop it

    blocks.sort((x, y) => (x[0]-y[0]) || (x[1]-y[1]) || (x[2]-y[2]))
      # Python does blocks.sort() on 3-tuples = lexicographic on (i, j, size).
      # JS default sort is LEXICOGRAPHIC ON STRINGS -- you MUST pass this
      # comparator or "10" sorts before "9".

    # ADJACENT-BLOCK COALESCING (added in Python 2.5)
    i1 = 0; j1 = 0; k1 = 0            # k1 == 0 marks the dummy seed
    nonAdjacent = []
    for [i2, j2, k2] of blocks:
      if i1 + k1 === i2 and j1 + k1 === j2:
        k1 += k2                      # merge; the merged block stays the cursor
      else:
        if k1 != 0: nonAdjacent.push([i1, j1, k1])
        i1 = i2; j1 = j2; k1 = k2
    if k1 != 0: nonAdjacent.push([i1, j1, k1])

    # TERMINATING SENTINEL -- always appended, unconditionally
    nonAdjacent.push([la, lb, 0])
    cache and return nonAdjacent

replace/delete/insert for the tail. For an empty-vs-empty comparison the whole
result is just [[0,0,0]].

Note: because the result is sorted, using shift() instead of pop() would give
the same answer, but keep pop() for fidelity.

      #                ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^  clamps to i1 when the block is shorter
      #                                 than n. NEVER let it go below i1.

    # -- trailing context trim: keep at most the FIRST n lines of a trailing equal

      [tag, i1, i2, j1, j2] = codes[last]

    # same row, in that order (leading first). Both are idempotent.

    nn = n + n                       # 6 for n = 3

        # equal block. i2/j2 are unchanged; only i1/j1 move forward.

    function formatRangeUnified(start, stop):     # _format_range_unified
      beginning = start + 1                       # ed/diff line numbers are 1-based
      length = stop - start
      if length === 1: return String(beginning)         # "7"  -- no ",1"
      if length === 0: beginning -= 1                   # empty range sits BELOW
      return beginning + ',' + length                   # "6,0" / "247,4"

    function unifiedDiff(a, b, n = 3, lineterm = ''):
      out = []; started = false
      sm = new SequenceMatcher(null, a, b)     # isjunk = null, autojunk = true
      for group of sm.getGroupedOpcodes(n):
        if not started:
          started = true
          fromdate = fromfiledate ? '\t' + fromfiledate : ''    # '' here
          todate   = tofiledate   ? '\t' + tofiledate   : ''    # '' here
          out.push('--- ' + fromfile + fromdate + lineterm)     # -> '--- '
          out.push('+++ ' + tofile   + todate   + lineterm)     # -> '+++ '
        first = group[0]; last = group[group.length - 1]
        r1 = formatRangeUnified(first[1], last[2])   # a-side: first.i1 .. last.i2
        r2 = formatRangeUnified(first[3], last[4])   # b-side: first.j1 .. last.j2
        out.push('@@ -' + r1 + ' +' + r2 + ' @@' + lineterm)
        for [tag, i1, i2, j1, j2] of group:
          if tag === 'equal':
            for line of a.slice(i1, i2): out.push(' ' + line)   # SPACE prefix

          if tag === 'replace' or tag === 'delete':
            for line of a.slice(i1, i2): out.push('-' + line)
          if tag === 'replace' or tag === 'insert':
            for line of b.slice(j1, j2): out.push('+' + line)

The payload is joined with a single '\n' at the DeepDiff level, never with lineterm and never with '\r\n'. A CRLF or CR-only input still produces an LF-joined payload.
